subject: ONE plump emperor penguin in a red knitted scarf, two identical green banknotes tucked in his belly fold, never held in one pose
second_characters: TWO seagulls flapping across the lens only in the silent beats

props.big: ONE chunky chrome currency exchange machine with a banknote slot, a coin chute and a plain blue screen; gold coins
props.small: A SWARM of snowflakes tearing across the lens

environment: a busy snowy city street at noon packed with shop windows, garlands, parked scooters and a newsstand, no empty ground
lighting: bright sunny winter noon, hard daylight on snow, cyan edge left, warm amber rim right; at 2.15 the machine screen flashes from blue to red
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the penguin fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, his face never under a quarter of it. The camera always moving, it orbits the penguin on a tight arc, shot size drifts every beat within the orbit, chest-up to very close. He stays at the machine but his whole body works: flippers flapping, belly bouncing, feet stamping. Snowflakes cross the lens in EVERY beat. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: flat low male voice, dry and unbothered
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.35, then the machine and seagulls carry it
audio.lip_sync: face turned to the lens, beak opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: PER-va-ya ob-me-NYA-las. fta-RA-ya, VI-di-mo, na-SHLA svoy KURS v MI-nus

timeline.a: chest-up, face turned to the lens, beak working on every word, the tail of a green banknote vanishing into the slot, he slaps the machine and scoops gold coins gushing from the chute into his belly fold
he pulls the identical second green banknote from his belly fold and feeds it into the slot
the screen flashes red and he clutches his belly fold with both flippers as every gold coin flies out of it back up the coin chute

timeline.line: Вторая, видимо, нашла свой курс в минус.
timeline.a: very close, face turned to the lens, beak working on every word, he turns the empty belly fold inside out with both flippers, then slaps the machine
the slot catches the end of his red scarf and he watches it unwind off his neck, a seagull flapping across the lens
he tugs the scarf back once with a flipper, then lets go
the scarf zips into the slot, his neck bare, he shakes out his feathers, snowflakes bursting across the lens
the machine spits ONE tiny gold coin that bounces off his head, his neck bare
he catches the tiny coin in a flipper and holds it up to his eye
he tucks the tiny coin into his empty belly fold and pats it once
he turns his face to the lens with a flat stare and blinks once, a seagull bursting up across the lens

must_appear: 0.00 the penguin at the machine scooping coins into his belly fold; 1.45 the identical second green banknote; 2.15 red screen and coins flying from his belly back up the chute; 6.75 bare neck, no scarf; 9.50 his flat stare at the lens
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a hero running, a conveyor belt, a cart, rails, a camera travelling beside the hero, a parked camera, a still or empty background, push in, wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, night, dark scene, fog, a hero back to the camera, a banknote between his beak, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.35, English speech, foreign accent, a penguin crowd, a human cashier, a third banknote
